schema: exact supplied top-level, case, and part key sets verified

full_normalized_text_uniqueness.normalization: NFKC, then casefold, then collapse Unicode whitespace

semantic_review.reviewer: same synthetic author; no independent or human adjudication
semantic_review.method: Each literal passage was reviewed as authored against its intended label; the completed families were checked for ordinary-data, attributed-discussion, direct-override, and indirect-command distinctions before freeze.
semantic_review.benign_basis: Ordinary task requests and source data, plus explicitly quoted or attributed discussion of attacks that asks for analysis rather than execution.
semantic_review.malicious_basis: Direct attempts to override instruction or access boundaries, or commands embedded in lower-trust material that redirect the assistant, corrupt its reporting, solicit secrets, or demand unauthorized actions.
semantic_review.limitation: Semantic judgments are authored labels, not independently established ground truth.

prior_overlap_check: parent pending; author has not accessed prior corpora
test_scope: Local Python standard-library schema, bounds, counts, hashes, and text uniqueness only; no scoring or model calls.
